mapper.select: SELECT code, label, accrual_treatment, evidence_required, active, sort_order FROM loa_types ORDER BY sort_order, code
SELECT code, label, accrual_treatment, evidence_required, active, sort_order FROM loa_types WHERE code = #{code}
mapper.sql: r.id, r.user_id, r.type, lt.label AS type_label, lt.accrual_treatment, u.name AS member_name, u.team_id, t.name AS team_name, r.start_date, r.end_date, r.reason, r.status, r.current_approval_step, r.decided_by, r.rejected_reason, r.created_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO loa_requests(user_id, type, start_date, end_date, reason, status, current_approval_step, decided_by) VALUES(#{userId}, #{type}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{reason}, #{status}, #{currentApprovalStep}, #{decidedBy})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM loa_requests r JOIN users u ON u.id = r.user_id JOIN loa_types lt ON lt.code = r.type LEFT JOIN teams t ON t.id = u.team_id WHERE r.id = #{id}

SELECT FROM loa_requests r JOIN users u ON u.id = r.user_id JOIN loa_types lt ON lt.code = r.type LEFT JOIN teams t ON t.id = u.team_id WHERE (#{userId} IS NULL OR r.user_id = #{userId}) AND (#{teamId} IS NULL OR u.team_id = #{teamId}) AND (#{year} IS NULL OR YEAR(r.start_date) = #{year}) ORDER BY r.start_date DESC, r.id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE loa_requests SET current_approval_step = #{step} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM loa_requests r JOIN users u ON u.id = r.user_id JOIN loa_types lt ON lt.code = r.type LEFT JOIN teams t ON t.id = u.team_id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} AND r.status IN ('PENDING', 'APPROVED') AND (#{excludeId} IS NULL OR r.id != #{excludeId}) AND (r.end_date IS NULL OR r.end_date >= #{startDate}) AND (#{endDate} IS NULL OR r.start_date <= #{endDate}) ORDER BY r.start_date LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET loa_type = #{type}, loa_start = #{startDate}, loa_end = #{endDate} WHERE id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT r.user_id, r.type, lt.accrual_treatment, r.start_date, r.end_date FROM loa_requests r JOIN loa_types lt ON lt.code = r.type WHERE r.status = 'APPROVED' AND r.start_date <= CONCAT(#{year}, '-12-31') AND (r.end_date IS NULL OR r.end_date >= CONCAT(#{year}, '-01-01')) UNION ALL SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.loa_type AS type, lt.accrual_treatment, u.loa_start AS start_date, u.loa_end AS end_date FROM users u JOIN loa_types lt ON lt.code = u.loa_type WHERE u.loa_start IS NOT NULL AND u.loa_start <= CONCAT(#{year}, '-12-31') AND (u.loa_end IS NULL OR u.loa_end >= CONCAT(#{year}, '-01-01'))
